name: Benchmarking portfolio approaches for constraint satisfaction problems
description: In the context of Constraint Programming, a portfolio approach exploits the complementary strengths of a portfolio of different constraint solvers. The goal is to predict and run the best solver(s) of the portfolio for solving a new, unseen problem. In this work we reproduce, simulate, and evaluate the performance of different portfolio approaches on extensive benchmarks of Constraint Satisfaction Problems. Empirical results clearly show the benefits of portfolio solvers in terms of both solved instances and solving time.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focusing on solver runtime and success; results depend on solver versions and hardware; commonly evaluated with solved-instance counts and PAR10, so comparisons require careful experimental control.
